name: Select
purpose: Select a single value with a consistent Fluent Calm listbox popup instead of a browser-native select menu
slots: Light-DOM option and optgroup children as declarative data; not displayed directly
theme: Uses semantic Fluent Calm CSS custom properties for Light/Dark/density/accent; popup is drawn inside Shadow DOM

accessibility.control: role=combobox, tabindex=0, aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-labelledby or aria-label, aria-activedescendant
accessibility.popup: role=listbox, role=option, role=group for optgroup, aria-selected, aria-disabled
keyboard: Enter/Space: open or commit highlighted option
Home/End: first or last enabled option
notes: Pointer selection emits cu-input and cu-change only when value changes
Popup may flip above on limited viewport space
Confirm with real screen readers before production release
